method.localSpace: Source geometry POSITION and normalized COLOR_0 getters; no source buffers or asset files modified.
method.skirt: t=1-smoothstep(-.006,.018,y); delta x/z=-.45*t*(x/z), delta y=-.008*t for both roles.
method.soft: f=clamp(R,0,1)^1.8; absolute sway limits |x|<=1.38*A*f, |z|<=1.10*A*f, downward y<=.18*2.48*A*f^2.
method.sphere: For each source vertex, bound the norm of combined tuck/sway displacement. Add maximum displacement plus numeric pad to the original geometry sphere; triangle inequality and sphere convexity cover every vertex and triangle interior. This is a continuous algebraic bound, not a finite-time pose fit.
method.numeric: 10micrometers times max(1, per-axis source/displaced magnitude); Float32 uniform, individual sway, abs-sway sum and output overflow fail open to infinite sphere.
method.cache: WeakMap per shared geometry stores original sphere and monotone maximum margin; repeated clones/rebuilds do not accumulate expansion. Assembly.update checks amplitude changes before culling.
